This is a Guide page.
This means the page will walk you through a specific task, strategy, or enemy/boss fight.
This guide was last updated for version 2.1.2.
This guide is not updated for the current version of the mod. Some or all of its advice may not be applicable to the current patch.

This guide is intended to list viable options for players depending on their progression stage and the class they've chosen. Think of this guide as a menu — there are many options to choose from, and you should try out different things to see which work best for you. Additionally, this guide is a starting point for you to build your own loadout from; you are encouraged to make changes to your liking. Be sure to check the individual pages for the items to understand how to craft them or their functionalities.

You should note the following things:

  • This guide is written assuming you are playing on Expert difficulty and Revengeance Mode. This guide may not be accurate for Death Mode, or anything on Master difficulty.
  • Calamity changes many vanilla items and mechanics. You can read these changes here.
  • Summoner weapons and minions will only do 0.75x damage if used alongside weapons from a different class.
  • The rogue class is a new class created by the Calamity Mod. It has a unique stealth mechanic that adds new attacks to its weapons. Not using stealth and simply using the weapon as fast as possible is referred to as "spam".
  • Each of the entries are sorted by category and listed alphabetically. The order does not signify how powerful something is.
  • Each of the items listed here is good, so if you don't like one, try another!

Using the guide[edit]

This guide uses the following symbols to help you understand how to use some items:

† — This item can be difficult or risky to use, and requires boss preparation

C — This item is best used for crowd control, such as Events or Worm bosses

+ — Support items that debuff the enemy or benefit the player in some way, or secondary weapons that can be used occasionally

≤ — Or variants / upgrades

Δ — This item has significant Calamity changes by way of functionality

* — This item might be difficult and tedious to get at this stage

Ω — These items should be used together

Items restricted to Revengeance Mode or higher will be italicized.

Pre-Mechanical Bosses [edit]

Entering Hardmode greatly expands the potential equipment options for every class. Life Fruits become available immediately, and you can craft a Comet Shard to increase your maximum mana. You can defeat Queen Slime or Cryogen for weapons and armor. There are several changes to the world: the Astral Infection and Hallow will appear, while the Sunken Sea and Brimstone Crag now feature tougher enemies and new loot. A powerful new hook, the Serpent's Bite, can now be obtained. The Calamity Mod also adds a config option to rework early Hardmode progression. This guide will assume that that option is on.

Post-Mechanical Boss 1 [edit]

After defeating your first Mechanical Boss, you will have access to the second tier of Hardmode Ore and the Hardmode Anvils. You will also be able to mine Infernal Suevite at the Brimstone Crag. After grabbing the improved gear available at this tier, it is recommended you fight the Aquatic Scourge at the Sulphurous Sea to unlock the second tier of the Acid Rain event. The Solar Eclipse can now randomly appear, offering useful weapons and accessories as well as the Bat Hook, dropped by Vampires. This should prepare you for the next Mechanical Boss fight.

Post-Mechanical Boss 2 [edit]

With your second Mechanical Boss defeated, you should now have access to the third tier of Hardmode Ore. You can now mine Cryonic Ore in the Ice biome if you have defeated Cryogen. The Brimstone Elemental can be challenged for some weapons. All of these items should allow you to face your final Mechanical Boss.

Pre-Plantera [edit]

After killing the final Mechanical Bosses, you now have access to Hallowed Bars and Chlorophyte Bars. If you find yourself short on Hallowed Bars, Hallowed Ore will also have generated in the Underground Hallow. The Sanguine Tangerine can now be crafted to increase your maximum HP beyond what is obtainable from Life Fruit. The Calamitas Clone can be fought for new gear and for Solar Veils, dropped during the Solar Eclipse. Once ready, it's time to take on Plantera.

Pre-Golem [edit]

With Plantera defeated, Perennial Ore spawns. Enemies in the Dungeon become much stronger and begin dropping Ectoplasm. Sandstorms can spawn the Great Sand Shark, offering weapons and a new crafting material. You should fight Leviathan and Anahita and Astrum Aureus at this stage, with the former unlocking new crafting materials in the Abyss and the latter offering many new weapons from Astral Infection enemies as well as the Starlight Fuel Cell power-up. The Solar Eclipse now has new enemies that drop new weapons. When you're prepared, enter the Jungle Temple and challenge Golem.

Post-Golem [edit]

Defeating Golem gives you access to Scoria Ore in the third layer of the Abyss, and Plague enemies will begin spawning in the Jungle. Make sure to consume a Miracle Fruit to increase your maximum HP. You can also take on the Martian Invasion, the final stage of the Old One's Army, and the two event moons: the Frost Moon and the Pumpkin Moon.

Pre-Lunar Events [edit]

Using the new equipment from the previously mentioned events and environments, you should take on some of the more difficult Hardmode bosses: the Plaguebringer Goliath, the Empress of Light, Duke Fishron, and Ravager. Their drops will prepare you for your penultimate challenges, the Lunatic Cultist and the Lunar Events.

Pre-Moon Lord [edit]

With the Lunatic Cultist defeated, you now have the Ancient Manipulator. After defeating a couple of the pillars and crafting new gear with Meld Constructs and Lunar Fragments, you can take on your second-to-last Hardmode boss: Astrum Deus, who unlocks Astral Bars. All of this grants you access to many new accessories and weapons, as well as the Ethereal Core to boost your maximum mana. The Lunar Hook, the best hook from now until halfway through Post-Moon Lord, can now be obtained. With this, you should be fully prepared to take on the final boss of Hardmode, the Moon Lord.
